headline: The wait continues in Lil Durk @lildurk’s trial, with another day ending without a verdict
body: The wait continues in Lil Durk @lildurk’s trial, with another day ending without a verdict. 👀⚖️ According to the latest court update, this marks the second straight day without a decision being announced. There’s still no confirmed outcome, and the time taken to reach a verdict alone doesn’t indicate which way the case will go. We’ll share further updates as more information becomes available. 📸: Alberto E. Rodriguez / Getty Images
